cues.text: In a back street of the Iwatodai strip mall, four men crowd around the two girls from before. You and Akihiko walk up a little way off and stop to watch.
Akihiko frowns and walks straight over to the group, and you follow him.
The men turn on Akihiko, and the two girls run off.
One of the men swings a fist at Akihiko. Akihiko slips it without effort. The biggest of them, a hard-faced man, steps up beside him.
Later, you and Akihiko stand outside a row of shops in the strip mall with two police officers. Akihiko looks troubled.
Another policeman walks over to the group. The other two officers nod and walk away.
Akihiko sets off at a run, and you run after him.
